title: Civil Engineering Draftsperson
abstract: Roesner and Hamilton Consulting is looking for a reliable Civil Engineering Draftsperson (ANZSCO: 312211) to join our growing team based in Nerang.
company: Roesner and Hamilton Consulting Engineers Pty Ltd
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as a civil drafter?
How many years of Road Design experience do you have?
content_text:
Roesner and Hamilton Consulting is looking for a reliable Civil Engineering Draftsperson (ANZSCO: 312211) to join our growing team based in Nerang.  We offer a fun and inclusive work environment with a culture based on teamwork.
We are looking for someone who has over 3 years of experience and is qualified in Civil Drafting.
Key Responsibilities:
- Preparing engineering drawings using AutoCAD
- Undertake engineering calculations
- Assist designers, engineers and Project Managers
- Undertake administration work.
Qualifications and Skills: 
- Diploma in Engineering Technical & Construction Design (or similar)
- Proficient in AutoCAD
- Experience in 12d (desirable)
In exchange Roesner and Hamilton will offer you:
- Strong forward workload with excellent learning and development opportunities.
- A competitive remuneration package
- Work/life balance
- Team Building Activities
Schedule:
- Ability to work Monday to Friday
- Permanent, full-time position
